tasks.short: Adapt terrazzo working procedures to the material and installation

steps.what: Inspect the installation and material behaviour
Look up relevant material instructions for mixing, grinding or cleaning
Choose modifications to the mixing, grouting, grinding or cleaning procedure
Adjust the physical process to the chosen procedure
Check the surface response and refine the modification

tasks.design: Use a native material-index view in {DOCS} for the technical sheets the worker already consults. Inspection, procedure choice, physical adjustment and checking remain with the worker.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the correct existing technical sheet involves repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document indexing can shorten that lookup without recommending a process change.
tasks.still_hard: Material response and surface condition cannot be judged from a product label alone.
tasks.human_edge: Notice and correct the actual response of the terrazzo installation.
tasks.altitude: Reduce a small lookup burden while retaining practical judgement.

reach.learn: Compare instructions with observed installation behaviour

evidence.claim: An indexed technical-sheet collection can reduce navigation; no local saving is measured.

assumptions: The task is an on-site process adjustment, not necessarily a written procedure revision. No unrequested procedure log or trailing record is added.

The worker identifies the material and installation from labels and observation in s1, with that time retained, and checks the applicable sheet revision in s2. Missing identification requires manual investigation.

The native material index removes 1 of 10 existing lookup hours; it does not change instruction reading or choose the modification. If sheets are not consulted today, the lookup has no eligible baseline.
No AI, new capture system or recurring curation role is introduced. Current-sheet checking remains in s2, so separate incremental work is zero.
unknowns: Frequency and duration of actual technical-sheet lookup
Whether native indexing is already used
research_questions: Does an observed series of adjustments contain the assumed lookup work?

already_counted.description: Identify material, read applicable instructions and check physical response

incremental.description: No additional recurring work beyond retained sheet checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=99, zero upkeep gives 1 net. Conservative case: sheets are already directly accessible, retaining all 100 hours. A native index removing half an hour of navigation from the 10-hour lookup step retains 99.5 hours and gives 0.5 net. All 90 physical and judgement hours stay retained in both cases.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Position the concrete truck and direct its chute

steps.what: Assess truck access, form position and a safe pouring route
outputs: assessed truck position and chute route

steps.what: Signal the truck driver to position the truck for pouring
inputs: assessed truck position and chute route

steps.what: Move the chute to direct concrete onto the forms
Check placement and adjust chute position as pouring proceeds

tasks.design: Retain live site assessment, driver signalling, chute movement and placement checks with the worker. No software action replaces the physical positioning and pouring work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Live spatial coordination and physical movement determine performance.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported template or native setting removes a named action.
tasks.still_hard: Truck movement, people and concrete flow change continuously.
tasks.human_edge: Maintain shared awareness and react to the actual site.
tasks.altitude: Keep direct control of pouring coordination.

evidence.claim: Document templates and native administrative settings do not perform the task's live signalling or chute movement.

assumptions: The truck driver is an external supplier in this case; internal colleague signalling would use write_internal instead. No external message or document send is implied beyond the live signal.
The worker produces the spatial assessment by direct observation in s1 and continuously checks it in s2-s4; capture time is included and no structured location feed is assumed.

No record, lookup or delivery docket write is named in the task or needed for the listed live actions; no trailing administrative step is invented. Native views, templates and till settings touch none of these steps.
No new tool, monitoring or administration is introduced, so incremental work is zero.
unknowns: Site-specific division of signalling and chute duties
research_questions: Does direct observation identify any existing record or lookup genuinely inside this task rather than a separate delivery transaction?

already_counted.description: Assess and check the live spatial conditions

approvals.approved_version: The exact current movement signal to the identified driver and observed truck position; any site or movement change requires reassessment

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=100 and zero new upkeep. Both conservative and favourable cases retain site assessment, signalling, chute movement and checking. No administrative saving is assumed for the physical pouring task.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep material judgement and physical coordination with the terrazzo worker.
reach: Coordinate clearly with drivers and flooring supervisors
role.ambitious_version: A skilled terrazzo worker with accessible material references and direct control of installation quality.
